Configure Timesheet Set up Tee Times and Tee Time Intervals for individual days, months and years. Green Fee Rates Set up Green Fee Categories and Rates for Visitors, Societies, Member Guests, etc. Reservation Types Set up the Reservation Types and choose their colours. Booking Statuses Set up the Booking Statuses supported. Payment Methods Set up the Payment Methods supported. Contact Categories Set up the Contact Categories supported. This tool is used to create a number of standard email and letter templates. e.g. confirmation of booking, confirmation that the deposit was received, thank you message, etc. Email and Letter Templates Category: Golf Room Payment Request Type: Email Letter Description: Text: The following tags apply to emails and letters for Golf bookings only. They are not supported for Room/Facility bookings. Click on the field names below to enter values at the current cursor position within the text of the letter or email. Please enter the tags exactly as they appear in the table below i.e. use UPPERCASE with no spaces. To automatically add the text such as 'Dear Mr Smith' to the start of the letter, you will need to add the text 'Dear R_TITLE R_SURNAME'. TAG Description R_LOGGEDINUSER Logged in User R_TITLE Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr, etc R_FIRSTNAME Firstname R_SURNAME Lastname / Surname R_CLUBNAME Club Name R_COURSENAME Course Name (only applicable if 2 or more courses) R_DATE Date of booking in format 'Mon. 19th Feb. 2007' R_FULL_DATE Date of booking in format 'Monday 19th February 2007' R_TODAYSDATE Todays Date in format '19-Feb-2007' R_STARTTIME Start Time in format 09:20 R_ENDTIME End Time in format 11:20 (Applies to block bookings only) R_STARTTEE Name of the Start Tee, e.g. "1st", "10th", "Red 9", "Blue 9" (applies to 2 tee start and 27 hole courses only) R_BACK9_TEE Name of the 2nd 9 Tee, e.g. "1st", "10th", "Red 9", "Blue 9" (applies to 2 tee start and 27 hole courses only) R_BACK9_STARTTIME Start Time on the back 9 in format 09:20 (applies to 9, 2 tee start and 27 hole courses only) R_BACK9_ENDTIME End Time on the back 9 in format 11:20 (applies to 9, 2 tee start and 27 hole courses only) R_REFERENCENUMBER System Reference Number R_CLUBREFERENCENUMBER Club Reference Number R_NUMBERTEETIMES Number of Tee Times R_NUMBERROUNDS Number of Rounds R_COMPANYNAME Company / Group Name R_RESERVATIONNAME Reservation Name R_CONTACTONTHEDAY Contact of the Day R_CURRENCY Currency Symbol R_TOTALPRICE Total Price R_DEPOSIT Deposit Requested R_TOTALPAYMENTS Total Payments R_OUTSTANDINGBALANCE Outstanding Balance R_EMAIL Email Address R_TELEPHONE_WORK Telephone (Work) R_TELEPHONE_HOME Telephone (Home) R_MOBILE Mobile R_FAX Fax R_ADDRESS1 Address R_ADDRESS2 Address (Cont) R_TOWN_CITY Town / City R_COUNTY County R_COUNTRY Country R_POSTCODE_ZIP Postcode / Zip Help Button Launcher......
